app_user_one_active_partner_account.name: app_user_one_active_partner_account
app_user_one_active_partner_account.where: "app_user"."partner_id" IS NOT NULL AND "app_user"."deactivated_at" IS NULL AND "app_user"."voided_at" IS NULL

app_user_active_partner_linked.name: app_user_active_partner_linked
app_user_active_partner_linked.value: "app_user"."role" <> 'partner' OR "app_user"."partner_id" IS NOT NULL OR "app_user"."deactivated_at" IS NOT NULL OR "app_user"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL

product_conversion_valid.name: product_conversion_valid
product_conversion_valid.value:
("product"."kg_to_meter_weight_g" IS NULL AND "product"."kg_to_meter_length_cm" IS NULL AND "product"."kg_to_meter_source" IS NULL)
        OR ("product"."kg_to_meter_weight_g" > 0 AND "product"."kg_to_meter_length_cm" > 0 AND "product"."kg_to_meter_source" IS NOT NULL)

expense_salary_booked_valid.name: expense_salary_booked_valid
expense_salary_booked_valid.value: "expense"."employee_id" IS NULL OR ("expense"."category" = 'wages' AND "expense"."paid_date" IS NOT NULL)

product_batch_conversion_valid.name: product_batch_conversion_valid
product_batch_conversion_valid.value:
("product_batch"."conversion_weight_g" IS NULL AND "product_batch"."conversion_length_cm" IS NULL AND "product_batch"."conversion_source" IS NULL)
        OR ("product_batch"."conversion_weight_g" > 0 AND "product_batch"."conversion_length_cm" > 0 AND "product_batch"."conversion_source" IS NOT NULL)
